task_instance: Build a redacted Bright Data support bundle from a sample run receipt plus a collector log (both containing proxy credentials, a Bearer API key, a cookie header, the target URL with query, and response-body target data): produce a shape-only manifest, allowlisted redacted diagnostics, a fail-closed zero-secret scan, and a sorted file-hash seal with retention metadata.
evidence: Work dir real2_work/r181. Created inputs/run_receipt.json and inputs/collector.log holding real-shaped secrets (proxy user/password, live API key, Bearer token, Cookie header, target URL with session/token query, JSON response-body with buyer email). Step 1: Grep over inputs confirmed where each secret lives before copying. Step 2-4 implemented in build_bundle.py (run with python3 -I, no network, no installs) producing four bundle files: manifest.json (product, zone_alias, client/runtime version, rounded-to-minute UTC window, operation_id, state, provider_code, raw_payload_included:false); diagnostics.json (allowlist only: proxy_status, x_brd_err_code=client_10000, rounded UTC window, opaque operation id, final_state); secret_scan.json (scans the shipped payloads against 13 forbidden patterns, reports matches as truncated sha256 labels not raw values, result PASS zero secrets); seal.json (sorted sha256 of each shipped file, incident owner, purpose, recipient as the approved private support channel described in words, retention deadline, deletion owner, transmit-via note). Verified: (a) independent recursive grep of the whole bundle for all 14 secret substrings returned CLEAN while the source inputs still contain them; (b) hash-integrity recheck recomputed sha256 of every sealed file and matched seal.json (True); (c) fail-closed path exercised earlier when a stale scan file still held raw values the builder exited non-zero and reported quarantine, confirming the validate step actually blocks. No bundled script/SDK/service was required by the skill (it specifies only Read/Grep/Write/Edit/Bash python), none were missing; no credentials, network, or MCP/connector tools used.
